title: Connection Problem in Crossover
author: kaansengul
body_snippet:
I try to run mRemoteNG (Portable and also installed via msi) in a Windows 10 bottle. When I try to connect a host I get this error:

> 2026-07-22 14:58:25,756 [2] INFO  - [#118-diag] entry GetFocus=0x102F8 icOwnsFocus=False clicked=Button
> 2026-07-22 14:58:25,756 [2] INFO  - [#118-diag] abort: FindInterfaceControl(GetFocus()) == null (guard short-circuit)
> 2026-07-22 14:58:25,947 [2] ERROR - Couldn't SetProps (Connection.Protocol.Base)
> 0x80040154 (REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG)
>    at void System.Run...
notes: Crossover/Wine: REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG - MSTSC ActiveX (mstscax.dll) not registered under Wine; RDP inherently needs MS COM control; suggest SSH/VNC/ext tools
